findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: open_photo_booth · Private data: plan_event_guestbook · Public sink: collect_guest_photos_info, plan_guest_photo_album.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: open_photo_booth · Private data: plan_event_guestbook · Public sink: collect_guest_photos_info, plan_guest_photo_album

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_photo_booth_effects" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Use this when the user asks which effects, filters or frames the online photo booth has (e.g. big head, meme, Halloween, wanted poster). Returns every effect with a short description." → after: "Use this when the user asks which effects, filters or frames the online photo booth has (e.g. big head, meme, mugshot, magazine cover, Halloween). Returns every effect with a short description."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
